data.name: A-Affordable Pool & Spa Service
data.address: 1616 W Hebron Pkwy Suite 104 Ste. 104, Carrollton, TX 75010

reviews.text: I called them and about 10 others in June. Not only did they answer the phone....which is rare but Jose was super friendly. They were able to repair my pool equipment in a few days. Everyone else I called it would take 3-5 days to get a call back or event get someone out just to look at my equipment. Secondly, during the repair service Jeff was very communicative. I also had them come out to look at stonework repairs, and repairing hail damage on the deck. I learned so much from John the owner who came out to look at the repairs. As a result, I will be switching over my monthly service to them as well. Very communicative, quality and timely repairs.... Just great people!!!
reviews.author: Jennifer Pettinato

reviews.text: We recently had our DE filter and chlorinator replaced by A-Affordable. While replacing our DE filter, the tech noticed our check valve wasn't chlorine resistant and was pretty much destroyed. We had him inatall a new check valve. Later Jeff called and told us the parts store sent the wrong check value, and A-Affordable would come back and replace the incorrect part for free. It has been a long time since I have had someone admit a mistake happened and then fix it for free. These guys really do quality work and care about doing the right thing.
reviews.author: R Rapp1321

reviews.text: I had a cracked pipe below the surface that caused the pool to lose almost 2 inches of water daily. The tech immediately was able to find the crack through pressure testing and repaired in one day! Affordable pools is great to work with, I would definitely use them again!
reviews.author: tinydancer05

reviews.text:
I called 14 pool companies around north DFW at 5pm one night because I needed a pool inspection ASAP in order to close on my new house. Jeff with A Affordable was one of TWO who answered my call, and he beat the price of the other company by half!

Jeff got me scheduled the very next day and true to his word went out to inspect. However, the pool wasn’t in working condition (sellers fault)…and from that point forward this whole situation became an absolute mess. I must have contacted Jeff a million times over the next 4 days as I went back and forth with the sellers of the house, trying to get the pool handled so we could close. Jeff was gracious, accommodating , patient, and supportive anytime I needed a new inspection (he had to go out three separate times!) or had questions about the pool.

We FINALLY got the pool fixed, inspected (by Jeff), and we closed on our house! A Affordable earned my business for life. As soon as we move in I’m having them come out to make sure it’s swim-ready for summer. Thank you thank you thank you, you will never know how much I appreciate you!
reviews.author: Jaymie Wright

reviews.text: A affordable Pools is a great company to do business with. They are reliable and keep their commitments. I have no worries about my pool anymore.  No longer hassle and worry about my pool maintenance. Best money you will ever spend. I now spend my weekends relaxing and enjoying my pool rather than running to pool supply store to get chemicals trying to figure out how to keep my pool sparkling clean.  Thank you, Aaffordable, you guys are AWESOME!!!
reviews.author: Nancy Lawrence

reviews.text:
Experience with Suntex for the last few yeasrs have been great.  Customer Service, especially with Casey, is excellent as well as Bryan, who cleans our pool.  Do appreciate everything they do.
Oh.  Not to forget about Preston who services our pool.

Do wish the monthly price could be lower.  Would like to see if the pool owner could supply the chlorine, which may help to bring the monthly charge down.  Understanding the grades of chlorine, if Suntex provides a list of suppliers, that may ease the issue of the different grades.  Yes, I agree, proof of purchase should be required.

Anyway, Thank you once again.
reviews.author: Tim Tsui

reviews.text: Recently had issues with my Pentair pool pump. Tripped circuit breaker and quit altogether. Pump is 15 years old so I expected the worst. Jeff at Aaffordable pool supply gave me some pointers on diagnostic steps to take that paid off. Turns out it was a loose connection which burned a wire in the wall mounted timer. Simple fix and I am back in business. Thanks for all your help!
reviews.author: Roger Partridge

reviews.text: I needed a somewhat hard to find pool cleaner to replace an old one. Jeff Williams was able to find exactly what I needed, and his highly skilled technician delivered and installed it the same week.  I am so impressed with their integrity and skills.  Their tech knew exactly how to cut the hose sections so that they fit my pool, as well as installed new fittings in the pool side wall.  The unit works perfectly, and I actually saved a few $$ and lots of stress.  I wanted to share these so others can benefit from this team!
reviews.author: Annette Hall

reviews.text:
Avoid this company.  I was told very conflicting details when it came to billing. Was told it was $95 for the service call and first hour of labor and each additional 1/2 hour was $55 dollars.  I was charged $95 plus $165 for less than 1.5 hours work. The reason given was the that since work/labor was performed, the $165 was based on the services/repairs provided.  This is a total bait and switch tactic.  AVOID!!

I was never quoted a total, ever.  That is a complete lie. And your prices were hidden in the $95 service call for the first hour.
reviews.author: tom archer

reviews.text: Whenever I have "Pool Problems" I have been calling on A Affordable for over 20 years they never let me down and always gave me a reasonable price. I would recommend them for all your pool issues you can count on these guys every time.
reviews.author: William Strother

reviews.text:
I chose A Affordable Pools to completely remodel my pool and spa back in 2018.
They were the first ones I called DURING the famous ice storm in 2021 after my pool equipment froze and needed to be replaced. Typical issues as part of upkeep in any pool occurred since like a spa leak, new coping around pool that cracked during ice storm, and old wiring to the main box were all handled by A Affordable Pools in a professional and timely manner. I give them the highest rating in a time where it is tough to find people who want to work! These folks DO want your business and they earn it time and again!!
reviews.author: Cheryl Samberg

reviews.text:
I highly recommend A-Affordable Pool & Spa as the staff is extremely knowledgeable and helpful. They were able to repair my pool heater after my pool company told me it needed to replaced.  A-Affordable has experienced technicians that can fix problems that others can’t.
Thank you A-Affordable pool and spa.
reviews.author: Abby Russell

reviews.text: Excellent and timely service. In-store and home service by employees is great. On-site tech Bob is prompt and notified me before arrival.  New sale cell generator and and backflow valve installed and working great!
reviews.author: Scott Pipsair

reviews.text: I went in to get my water tested for free. Jośe was very helpful at the counter. I definitely will be returning to the store. They also repaired my Polaris cleaner and it runs like brand new.
reviews.author: Marc Torres

reviews.text: Jeff with A Affordable Pool & Spa was a pleasure to work with. He was incredibly responsive, always quick to answer questions and provide updates. His attention to detail and customer service stood out throughout the entire process. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a professional who truly cares about doing the job right.
reviews.author: Giut

reviews.text:
Submitted online for a repair, they contacted me next business day,  listened to my concerns and had a repair tech out within no time at all. Tech diagnosed the problem,  talked with me to be sure I knew what was going on,  and ordered a part needed.  He even put a temporary valve on the equipment so we had full function of the pool and spa until the motorized part arrived the next day.
Price was transparent,  everyone was easy to work with, and billing was a snap. Great company and if I need to have additional repairs,  I'll be sure to contact A Affordable first.
reviews.author: Phillip Sbanotto

reviews.text: They never showed up after making the appointment in the store.   After calling them they said that they got busy.   They never called to keep me updated.   Not going to use anymore after being a customer for 5 years.  They did not seem to really care that they have lost a customer.   UPDATE:   Owner called me to inform me that they had been out and provide GPS tracking to show that they had been out.   Looking at the bottom of the pool it would be impossible to tell because it was not cleaned.   Photos don't lie.  Details will be posted on Nextdoor for the folks in the neighborhood.
reviews.author: Scott Willey

reviews.text: I really appreciate their tech Bob's honesty and hard work! He was able to give us a great quote on our pool repairs, when other pool companies said that our pump was 'too small' for our size pool, etc. and wanted to do a bunch of repairs. He said our pump was the right size and was able to give us recommendations on other things that needed be done. He quoted us half of what the other pool company wanted. Will be their customer moving forward!!
reviews.author: Nancy Murphey

reviews.text:
I had a pretty bad experience with this company. They don’t clean my filters and my robot malfunctions every time they “clean” my pool. I had to do just as much work if not more bc these guys are so lazy they come in and out in 5 mins. I’m posting this review so that no one else has to suffer like I did.

They performed a backwash, my pool was clogged for weeks. They did a filter clean, and filter still not clean as you can see from the photos. Yet they will make all kinds of excuses all the time as to why the robot is not working or why they are not testing water supposedly winter doesn’t change your water. Lol okay.

We tested the water ourselves, and everything was off balance. Better to just do it ourselves.
reviews.author: Alan Li

reviews.text: The winter weather damaged a few things on my pool system.  A Affordable team has saved me a ton of money by replacing the damaged components and not advising me to purchase a new pump or heater. Great work so far!
reviews.author: Timothy Bolger

reviews.text: Great job, I appreciate their help and have used them several times over the last few years!
reviews.author: Michael King

reviews.text: I highly recommend A-Affordable. Colton and Jeff corrected my spa leak.They started with the easy and least expensive options and worked their way up until they found the issue. Also provide excellent in store customer service and water chemistry evaluations.
reviews.author: Gary Payne

reviews.text: My heater would come on by itself and would not shut off. Bob, with A Affordable Pool Service, came out to diagnose heater. Bob was extremely friendly, knowledgeable, and very quick in doing repairs. He showed up at the agreed appointment time and got right to work. He also explained what he was doing and why he was doing it, and what the desired outcome should be when finished. He was amazingly quick and when finished, we started the pool and heater and it preformed perfectly. I am more than satisfied with this company’s service and pricing. I would highly recommend them to anyone needing a great pool service company.
reviews.author: Michael Thomas

reviews.text: Went to a buddy's house for a pool party. Pool didn't look right. I didn't think anything could be done. Called A Affordable Pool and spoke with Jose. He was a miracle worker! He saved the party and the day! Definitely recommend!
reviews.author: Edward

reviews.text: I want to let everyone know how amazing this pool company is.  We just bought our home couple months ago and I needed some help with my pumps for pool.  Jose in the office was so helpful and treated me so with such respect and knew how nervous i was about getting pool fixed.   He sent Bob to my house the next morning.  Bob is a super great guy with ALOT of knowledge and experience.   He was so kind a such a gentleman.    He got my pump running in now time.  I highly recommend this pool company and especially Jose and Bob. Thank you so much for wasn’t mind.
reviews.author: Barbie Drennan

reviews.text:
Bob called me a day ahead of schedule to try and squeeze our repairs in asap before the weather turned. I appreciated the promptness, he was very informative and made the repairs super easy for us! We had the freezer guard, timer and filter gauge replaced and rewired.

Kyle Croutz helped to repair/replace my manifold on my pool pump and got my pool filtration back up and running! He was very knowledgeable and friendly!
reviews.author: Destiny Tupes

reviews.text: They remodeled my pool a couple years ago and I have been satisfied.  Recently the automation acted up - turned out to be a bad actuator.   The technician they sent was great and I was very satisfied with their work.
reviews.author: Kevin

reviews.text: Bob did an amazing job fixing our pool. He moved the chlorinator and put in a check valve before we even woke up! He was super efficient, knowledgeable and professional. I highly recommend this company for quality work at an affordable price!
reviews.author: Kellen O

reviews.text:
4/10/2025 UPDATE:  Once again, A-Affordable was very responsive, accommodating to my schedule and in out out quickly, taking care of my issue.  I highly recomment A-Affordable and have been using them consistenely and loyally for years.

6/10/2024 UPDATE:  A-Affordable came to the rescue once again.  Bob continues to provide the most professional and knowledgeable service.  He assured me my pool would be pristine by the weekend and he was right.  He gives a detailed description of the work done, and how to prevent future issues like what I had.  5 Stars is not enough for them, I give them 10!

4/4/2024 Update:  Still using A Affordable and am just as happy now as I was when I posted my first review below over 5 years ago.  I highly recommend them for their expertise, professionalism, reliability and price.  I've not met anyone as knowledgeable and helpful about pools and equipment than Bob.

2019 Review:  Anyone sharing less than 5 stars for this company either has a personal issue with this company or an extremely rare unsatisfactory transaction.  I have had to use this company, which came highly recommended, three times in the past 6 months.  Previous to them, my husband did most of any work, however, he recently passed away and I have come to rely on A Affordable Pool and Spa Service.  They had always been extremely responsive, very reliable, informative and affordable priced. I have dealt with both Bob and Greg and can't say enough great things about them.  You are wasting your time and money if you use anyone else.
reviews.author: Cindy Black

reviews.text: Bob came out to repair a frayed wire leading to the heater.  He quickly repaired the wire and was helpful with a couple of other questions that I had. I appreciate that A Affordable Pools staff answer my random questions, both in the store and on service calls.
reviews.author: Lisa Ingalls

reviews.text: If i could give 0 or negative stars i would. Their main issue is they assume their customers have basic knowledge of pool care, which they shouldn’t assume because they are supposed to be the professionals right?!! First we paid for pool school $150 and the guy teaching it didn’t know anything about salt water pool which is what we have, the owner did come out and teach us the salt water care but said it was the same amount of chemicals (hard to believe). We were getting our pool cleaned by them at this time. Even though their technician showed up without us ever booking an appointment. 3 times they said they would reach out to book and 3 times i was out of town getting a voicemail at 8am saying someone was coming that day! Then we called and said we were getting a inspect cell low salt lights on our salt box and they suggested a salt cell inspection of $95 and all that produced was we have no salt in the pool WOW! You’d think the guy coming to do our pool would have realized that but NO because he didn’t know anything about salt pools and we just paid $95 for someone to not even look at what was wrong with the cell box. Then they said you need 8 bags of salt, brought them all charged me. Only put 4 in, then came back put 2. Now i have two bags of salt I’m not going to use and they WONT LET ME RETURN THEM. SO SCAMMY! they don’t even care though. Why would you bring me 8 but only say i needed 4. They take incredible advantage of new inexperienced pool owners. Shame on them. And the guy who answers the phone is rude as hell. I gave them so many chances so you don’t have to. Stay away.
reviews.author: PilotLindsay

reviews.text: Good value, good work.A Affordable Pool & Spa Service Repaired my return manifold after a hard freeze. I then called them back to flush my DE filter. Both jobs were completed professionally and punctually.
reviews.author: Chris Utter

reviews.text: Aafordable pool and spa company completely resurfaced and retiled my pool a few years ago and did a good job at a fair price. However, when they installed a hand bar and “removed a stain” they left patches that simply were a mess. I was told that it would be corrected over a year ago. Also told over a year ago that the tile would be resealed. Nothing has happened. I don’t have a million dollar pool, but I still love it and like to keep it looking nice. In order for them to even say they’d take care of it, I had to call, email, and go to the store. Disappointed. Btw. The pics were taken almost two years ago.
reviews.author: Carol Haymes

reviews.text: I was having a problem with all of my pumps. Plus I had some leaking pipes. They came out right away. They gave me a fair price and did a great job. They also got it done in the same day. I was very impressed. Definitely would recommend them.
reviews.author: craig sanders

reviews.text: They give you a time frame of 2 days, then no one shows or calls. On the third day, we finally get a call. Yeah! Tech shows up and I explain what happened three times. He was insistent that what he said was right. He even put it on the invoice. Needless to say, he was wrong, did not listen to me and we ended up fixing the pump ourselves. Went to the store and told them what happened and the clerk literally turned and walked away. We were charged a service charge and got no service.
reviews.author: PDD

reviews.text: Colton was SO knowledgeable! He did a great job cleaning my DE filter. He also taught me how to correctly backwash the pool! Highly recommend!!
reviews.author: Sheryl

reviews.text: My first experience with Jeff was for a pool inspection on my new home, and more recently for leak detection. He was very professional and helpful and gave me lots of insights with good explanations for all of my many questions. What was thought to be a leak in a single spa jet turned out to be multiple, so we did a full spa re-plumb and had to break into the pool deck. Marcus did the repair and was very careful taking everything apart. He kept us updated every step of the way and considered our needs. He thought outside of the box to come up with a very helpful and cost-saving suggestion for us, which Jeff worked with us to accomplish. They took great care of us, despite several challenges, and I feel they care about us and not just their bottom line.
reviews.author: Michelle Shields

reviews.text:
I have used A-Affordable for several years and have always been happy with their work.  Most recently I have had repair issues on the pool equipment and needed guidance on how to correct the problems.
Jonathan has been very helpful with suggestions and help to repair a broken pool cleaner.  I appreciate his willingness to assist and his expertise in this area.  It is good to know that you can count on the technicians at A-Affordable to take care of any issues that come up in maintaining your pool and the equipment to run it.
reviews.author: Timmons Moorman

reviews.text: As a first time pool owner they have extremely helped me with all my questions they are very knowledgeable and my pool looks great thanks to all there help on how to keep it up to beat
reviews.author: Jose Garcia

reviews.text: The team (Mitch, Jose, & Jeff) are awesome! I’ve been going to them for years and they are always very helpful and trustworthy. Would highly recommend them for anyone looking for help with their pool.
reviews.author: William Wilson

reviews.text:
Can not and will not commit to service dates! Unable to communicate! I was supposed to have service technician call me to complete the work the first day they came out, they did not. The next week after taking $95.00 they did not put me on the schedule even after calling two times. Thursday they said no show, Friday they forgot! Then put on the schedule "Monday morning, first thing". Come Monday and a technician calls saying they need pictures, which I already sent, to "start the job on Tuesday" Really!? Tuesday! 12 days and A- affordable can not commit to a job!
05/11/23-update
The service technician came out on Tuesday and changed out the pump. He did a good job! The review is not based on the technician, but commitment and communication with A-Affordable.
reviews.author: Richard Nino

reviews.text: The technician that came to my house did a fantastic job. He arrived late in the day after a long shift and was cheerful and helpful. I was prepared for a new pump, but all it needed some some new o-rings to seal things up.  Saved me a lot of money and grief.  Kudos to the tech.
reviews.author: Clark Carradine

reviews.text: Great price. Responsive. They do what they say and don’t upsell you. Will use them again as my pool needs maintenance and repairs! They have installed a new cleaner, new skimmer, replumbed pipes, and repaired a leak in my spa! All top notch work!
reviews.author: Kellen Odom

reviews.text: Bob with Affordable Pools was my technician that was sent to fix my pool timer. He had to rewire the whole unit and replace the booster pump. He was great and efficient and explained everything. Great service as always!
reviews.author: Petsmart

reviews.text: These folks are awesome. I was amazed at how quickly Bob diagnosed the problems and got everything tuned up perfectly.  Plus, for the first time in 20 years we had the right length of hose for our Polaris 280. It was amazing watching him walk around the pool with the Polaris in hand figuring out exactly the perfect length. Best it's ever worked. I definitely recommend them.
reviews.author: Steven Crofts

reviews.text: I asked for an estimate.  They came out and replaced some of the things needing to be replaced, and then billed me for them.  They never gave me a price before hand, and I never said to actually "Do" any work.  I didn't even know they did any work until I got the bill.  I called the office and asked what the charges were for, which is when I was told it was for the work they did.  I went and checked and sure enough they replaced the backwash piston and a skimmer basket.  I told the office I had just wanted an estimate first.  They said they would have Bob call me (Bob is the guy who did the work).  I get a call the next day saying he has put my old piston and skimmer basket back.  What?  They didn't even tell me they were coming out to my property.  They didn't talk to me first about removing the equipment.  I was never angry with them on the phone.  I was just confused, due to the lack of communication.  each time I talked to Bob, he told me how he has been doing this for many years and he's a professional.  I've never worked with a professional who does a job without authorization, or who removes completed work without talking to the customer.  I'm just shocked at the lack of professionalism with this company.  Here's hoping it's not difficult to get my 250+ dollars back.
reviews.author: Michael Johnson

reviews.text: Quick response time and very reasonably priced! I was thinking that I needed a new motor but it ended up just being the capacitor. They replaced it on the spot and billed me. Awesome and definitely earned my trust!
reviews.author: syl wilson

reviews.text: We have had a great experience with A-Affordable.  We first worked with John to re-surface our pool.  We were impressed with the workers and job quality.  After the post re-surface program I decided to switch to A-Affordable for weekly pool cleaning/service.  Daryl is the service rep.  He has been here every week for the last two months.  He does a very thorough cleaning and always takes the time to explain the process and any problems that need to be addressed.  He has also done some minor repairs or part replacement to keep the system operating in top condition.  I am extremely satisfied with Daryl's performance and I enjoy talking with him each week.
reviews.author: JOHN GORMAN

reviews.text: I have used this company over fifteen years and they have always taken good care of my pool and equipment. Jeff is the owner and has always responded to any inquiry in a timely manner. They have replaced pumps, motors and most recently replaced a Polaris cleaner with an electric Dolphin cleaner which has been superior. Highly recommend them. Howard Kessner
reviews.author: Howard H Kessner

reviews.text:
Bob did a great job. I would recommend A-Affordable Pools for your next repair.

Just needs to work on their communication.

My project got bumped twice and I was unaware until I called their store to find that out.
reviews.author: Patrick Shotwell

reviews.text: They are very responsive and conscientious.  They communicate well and we have worked with them the last several years.  I have never had high pressure selling from them.  They have, at the same time, met all my maintenance needs.  They also maintain and clean our pool on a regular basis.  Our pool has lot of crepe myrtle trees around it and they work with us in dealing with it when needed.
reviews.author: ramgopal venkataraman

reviews.text: Every time after pool guy came I had to brush, push dust to the drain,  pick up leafs. I was supposed to be scheduled for Mondays but they have been coming up to 2 days after randomly. I never had a pool before but if I want it to see it clean I have to complete their work after they come. I called today to find out if someone actually came last week to clean my pool, since pool has been looking very dusty and today I saw algy formation is starting. The owner told me that He has been having problems with their cleaners and there is nothing He can do about it. After I expressed my disappointment He said, well in that case I will cancell your service since we cannot meet your standards and hung up on me. I do not recommend this business, owner is rude, customer service does not exist and you will never see your pool clean, you are warned.
reviews.author: Rafael G

reviews.text:
Simple job, pump motor capacitor change. Tech changed it, emptied the skimmer, put shock in the pool and put fire ant powder on a fire ant mound. Went above and beyond. Very happy with the service.

Second visit tech was very quick, efficient and I am very pleased with the results.
reviews.author: Guy Carusone

reviews.text: Very well stocked store and friendly,  knowledgeable staff.  My wife and I were in to buy supplies for our pool and the store was quite busy.  A staff member greeted us and assisted us in making a decision on our purchase.  Daryl told us he was one of the cleaning technicians but would be happy to help us.  His advice was honest and helpful and we actually saved money with his input.  We will certainly return and look forward to doing business with A AFFORDABLE in the future.
reviews.author: Tommy Dale

reviews.text: Had great service from Bob, he called to let me know when he would be here and competed the replacement pump install quickly and efficiently. Have used A affordable many times and never been disappointed.
reviews.author: George Johnston

reviews.text: As always, excellent service and repairs. My tank was leaking and I was out of town for Christmas. Jeff and his excellent technician kept me abreast of all repairs and secured my pool and home afterwards.I strongly recommend Affordable Pools for any pool repairs you need.
reviews.author: Timothy Quinn

reviews.text: Jeff and Bob do a great job of supporting their clients.  I just had Bob out to my home to do repairs that I have needed done for years.  Bob did such a great job replacing things that had to be replaced and not trying to upsell me unless he could show me it needed to be done.  I really appreciate the honest work he performed for me today.
reviews.author: brian jackson

reviews.text: Jose, Jeff, and Mitch are great! They are very knowledgeable, and helpful. And so encouraging in giving me the confidence to maintain my pool. I'm happy to have found them!!!
reviews.author: TamTam

reviews.text: I worked with Jeff and his team on all the new equipment we needed for our home.  His knowledge is top notch and was always great on communicating costs and timelines.  His installers as well were amazing.  I would recommend A Affordable for all your pool equipment needs!
reviews.author: Ben Im

reviews.text: A Affordable Pool has taken care of my pool for the last three years and I am extremely satisfied.  Like every pool service there are bumps in the road but they always stand behind everything they do.  Darrell takes care of the weekly maintenance and always takes the time to make sure our pool is perfectly clean and balanced.  There have been times when we needed an additional visit and a simple text to him and he's right there.  When I need repairs or parts they usually respond and have the repair done in less than 24 hours.  I highly recommend A Affordable and Darrell if you are in need of a pool service.
reviews.author: Mike Chasteen

reviews.text: Bob is very professional, helpful , and knowledgeable. He is the best one that I have interacted with. I strongly recommend Bob to your pool maintenance matter. Thank you, Bob. Keep up your excellent work 👏👏👏.
reviews.author: Tina Thao Tran

reviews.text: Terribly lacking in communication. Tried for a month to pursue this company to give them my business because my home warranty claimed this was a great company. Between myself and my home warranty company was billed for more than  $400 in services so that they could neglect my pool and have it turn brown from algae, drag feet to get me maintenance agreements and to get set up on a regular cleaning schedule, come BACK out for "repairs" needed due to neglect. Have kept my home warranty company apprised of the situation and STRONGLY recommended that they stop doing business with this company until it can show that customers matter. Only 2 stars because, when they finally did "grace us with their presence" the techs did a decent job.
reviews.author: jdwestbr

reviews.text: The person that came to provide the service was very knowledgeable and professional. The work was done with quality and solved my problems right away. Just needed to be patient on the scheduling giving the high work demand they have, that was my only concern.
reviews.author: Adolfo Kunz

reviews.text:
A Affordable Pools did a great job on replastering an updating our pool. John an Jeff were great to work with an their crews did a fantastic job. I would recommend them to family an friends. They have been there all the way through the process. Pool looks great.
Great job, well done.
reviews.author: jeff Brown

reviews.text: I was one of the many who had pool equipment damage due to the winter weather we had in February. I was on 3 different waiting lists and A Affordable came through first. The tech who came out to complete the repair was knowledgeable and patient with my questions. I will definitely use them again for any needed pool repair.
reviews.author: Jamie Jenkins

reviews.text: This company had been servicing our pool since the end of May this year. We hired them to do a leak detection test and they quoted us a price to fix the main drain (about $1200) and foam sealing of two skimmers ($675 each). As anyone would do, I called around and checked other companies for quotes. Every single well known reputable company I called was significantly cheaper. The one I ended up going with which is BBB approved, etc was less than half on the skimmer repair and $300 cheaper on the main drain repair, saving us a total of nearly $1000.00. I emailed A affordable to let them know I would be going with another company to make repairs but that I was still happy with the weekly service. They called me back to tell me that they no longer wish to do business with me at all. Definitely A Unaffordable.
reviews.author: Wendy Hairel

reviews.text: We were looking for a pool store that could both service a needed pool repair and provide weekly chemical service. Other people rated this store very highly. The store is convenient, clean, and staffed with friendly personnel. Due to the recent freeze, their service department is quoting service at 3-6 weeks out. They had chlorine which has become harder to get. They also have motors that have become harder to get. We plan to use this as our store of choice for pool supplies and service.
reviews.author: Ellen Daily

reviews.text: I was hoping to get the great service that I read about on some comments, but unfortunately that was not the case. It took 2 weeks for someone to come out due to 3 cancellations by them. I understand that cancellations happen, but we were never afforded a call to alert us that no one was coming. Each time we waited and then called to find out no one was coming. And in addition to that I feel their prices are high and felt overcharged. Afterwards I had a different company come out and 1 leak was not “caught/corrected” and they fixed that for $65. And in addition to that we were told we would get money off due to the scheduling issues. I reached out and received a very candid call. I’m not pushing for anything, I just don’t plan to work with this company further.
reviews.author: Andriana Mickens

reviews.text: Terrible service by their rep, Bob. According to the rep, he fixed the leak in my pump, but when I got home from work, the leak was just as bad, if not worse than before. I called the company and they said Bob would call back the following week. He called back Monday, but said that he wouldn't be able to do anything until I paid for the work completed. It was obvious from his tone that he was more concerned about getting paid than ensuring his customer was actually taken care of. I wouldn't recommend this company at all!!
reviews.author: Davis W

reviews.text: A Affordable was recommended to us by a friend. However, we will not be using them again. We asked to have a leak detection done, which they did (and in the process, knocked off several tiles, removed all of the nozzles in the pool (breaking about half in the process) and did something to the pump system that prevented us from being able to use the filter for almost two weeks, which resulted in us having an algae bloom) - we should've paid for the leak detection then and heeded the warning signs - but since they knew where the leak was, they confirmed that they'd be out on X day to fix the pipe. That day came and passed; I had to call to them to ask what the deal was and was promised they'd be out in another 2 days. Well, that came and went and then they called to say it'd be another five days before they could be out there. Please note that we were told we were "next on the list" of projects the entire time. After this third postponement, I called to inform them that I was looking for another pool servicer, but a manager wasn't in the building. When one called me back, he got our job mixed up with another job and didn't believe me when I told him that his description didn't match our job. After that debacle, they magically made room in their schedule to do our job the next morning. They did not replace the tiles, as requested, and the filter/pump system at least runs now. I'm also pretty sure we were grossly overcharged for their services (no offer was made for any reduction in cost due to length of delays or other damages caused), but after this CF, I just wanted to be done so we could move on. We won't be using A Affordable again and I urge caution before you look into using them.
reviews.author: Doug B

reviews.text: We were looking for someone to come out same day to do an inspection on pool equipment. A Affordable Pools went above and beyond to make it work and come out that afternoon!! We were beyond thankful. He did a wonderful job going over all the information with us and providing helpful feedback! I highly recommend using this company!! Thank you again! God Bless
reviews.author: Mommy V.

reviews.text:
Fixed the problem in two days.
It's expensive as usual. But happy to fix the air leak... all J valve changed, pot & cover canged...almost new line.
Good technician, knowledgeable, quick fix.
reviews.author: Avijit Mitra

reviews.text: Had a great experience. Bob came out. He was prompt, knowledgeable and professional.  He was very honest and fair. These guys have earned a long time customer here. I'll be calling them for all my pool needs and recommending them to friends as well.
reviews.author: mario lumbreras

reviews.text: My pool was leaking, full of algae and dirt, my original pool service was just not responsive, and wanted $13,000 to re-do the plumbing system and the deck.  Seek 2nd opinion from Jeff, and he sent Bob to find the leaks, fixed the leaks, clean the filter put my pool back in shape, added a fountain, all in one morning.  Next day the cleaning guy came clean out all algae, dirt and water once again is crystal clean.  Thank you, A-Affordable Pool guys.  Jeff, Bob and Arthur, they know their stuff, and extremely helpful.
reviews.author: Thomas Chu

reviews.text:
Called about a leak somewhere in my pump. They scheduled me, and came out a day early to diagnose the problem.
Then came back and fixed it… along with a few more little things!
Did I mention it was like a jillion degrees that day? In my backyard with mosquitoes and probably chiggers.
Then Bob called and told me exactly what he’d done. 18 stars!
reviews.author: Ellen Moriarty

reviews.text: John came out and gave us a bid and what really sold me were the 4 weeks of services after the plaster has been redone to make sure it is cured correctly to keep my pool looking good. His knowledge was  very thorough and I cannot wait to get the work done. His presentation sold me.
reviews.author: Kim Zinn

reviews.text: Performed Inspection service for new home. Arrived on time & issued Inspection details quickly. Then returned to discuss updates on pool & equipment. Again, arrived on time & gave a full explanation for work to be done. Issued written proposal & estimate. Continue to be available by phone & email. Friendly & timely. Look forward to having them fix up my pool & containing with weekly maintenance.
reviews.author: Katie Garrett

reviews.text: A Affordable Pool & Spa is a fantastic company.  All of their staff is friendly, knowledgeable and goes the extra mile to achieve customer satisfaction.  Nick, one their field technicians is especially helpful.  We've been impressed each time we've worked with him.  Great job Nick!
reviews.author: Houston Holloway

reviews.text: These guys have been very good to do business with so far.  I have used them for pool school, filter cleaning and replacing a check valve so far.  Always on time, always do what they say they are going to do.  Highly recommend this company.
reviews.author: BILL MCBRIDE

reviews.text: Awful experience. We used this company for pool cleaning and never once had a good experience. After a few weeks we realized that they were not cleaning the pool even though we were being charged for those services. But every time we called to complain there was a new excuse, and it was never fixed. After a few months, it became impossible. Our pool is in worse shape than it has been because we’ve had a run around for months, and this company refuses to take responsibility and continues to give us different stories about why we’ve never received the services we have paid for. A complete waste of money and a headache dealing with this company.
reviews.author: Adam Pierson

reviews.text: Called company out to take a look at my brand new saltwater pool (one month old) bc my generator was reading no flow. The return jets were almost not flowing at all. The service man was courteous. He blew out the main line with water to see if there was any obstructions. Nothing changed.  He looked at my filter and said it looked fine. He came to conclusion that there must be something stuck in skimmer line to the pump. They offered to blow it with co2 (on a different day) for $250. But if that didn't work they could call a plumber to dig out the line. He didn't have anything on hand to snake the line which I thought was strange since I would think getting debris or object stuck in a skimmer line is probably pretty common. He told me it wasn't common.  Either way I'm glad I called a family plumber. He came snaked the line, dug out the line to find out there was no obstruction. He cleared out all the lines with high pressured water. Nothing. Finally he wanted to test the pressure with out the filter to see if it was my actual filter (one month old). Bingo. It was my filter. My plumber figured out what the pool service ppl couldn't. My filter needs to be cleaned. That's it.  $90 service call diagnosed nothing. He didn't spray down my filter while he was here to see if that was the issue. This could have turned into a lot of $$$ wasted if I hadn't  trusted my instinct to call my plumber.  I called today to ask why my filter wasn't sprayed down to eliminate it as the culprit he said that would have been a different service. Wow. Save your money and call a different company. Or get a direct referral from a friend. This was a waste of money for us.
reviews.author: Melinda Leal

reviews.text: The repair was not worth it. Spend $400 to repair. The bot cleaner was slower than before the repair, but at least it work.  In less than a year, it broke again. Brought it over for them to take a look since it was still under the one year warrant. They fix it. It run for about a month and then it move like a turtle. Should never have repair it. Not worth it.
reviews.author: Hung Ho

reviews.text: Quick response to my initial inquiry and the team fit me into their busy schedule. Diagnosed my issue via phone and it was what they thought it was. Quick repair job and cost was just what they said.
reviews.author: Leslie Gibeault

reviews.text: Would definitely recommend! Bob helped us with our pool emergency and knocked the repairs out of the water! Thanks so much Bob for the quick response and great services.
reviews.author: Personal

reviews.text: Affordable has the technical knowledge and experience needed to correctly diagnose and fix the trickiest issues - most pool companies will soak you up front to "diagnose" the problem then quote you the fix. Affordable does everything possible to figure out what's wrong and define the best repair options - before they spend the customer's money. I trust their approach, experience and expertise.
reviews.author: Thomas Whalen

reviews.text: I've been dealing with a stubborn form of mustard algae in my pool all summer. After my 10th trip to my usual pool store, and another $30 worth of chemicals with no good result, I decided to try the guys at A Affordable. They took the time to test my water, explain the cause and source of the algae and how to treat it. The algae was gone in a few days. Very helpful and courteous; they're my new favorite pool store!!
reviews.author: Michael Mayer

reviews.text: We have been using A Affordable Pool and Spa for more than two years and love their service. Our pool technician Daryl does an outstanding job keeping out pool clean and clear all year round. I highly recommend them for your service needs.
reviews.author: David Turschmann

reviews.text: Jeff, Lopez, Frank, Bob, office staff and the rest of the team always do an excellent job. They do something that is not done enough in the service world today.....they communicate efficiently, effectively and on a timely basis.  We always know where we stand with service times, dates and progress..  This  effort is  an indicator of a company that you will want to work with.
reviews.author: March Maher

reviews.text: Kyle was great! Guarantee to get your issues fixed! Jeff at Aaffordable is friendly and knowledgeable. I highly recommend Aaffordable Pools!
reviews.author: Marcalot

reviews.text: Jeff and his team are always professional, courteous and timely with their service. They provide reasonably priced,accurate evaluation of how to manage and  care for our pool. We appreciate them all very much.
reviews.author: Stone Creek Neighbors

reviews.text: Stay a way from this  company. The owner, Jeff is literally a con artist and  fraud.  I  called them to come and perform a diagnostic to find out why my pump is not circulating water, first their guy showed up the day he was not supposed to come,  I  was nice to accommodate to his schedule,   I  left to my office and without my consent, the guy did bunch of unnecessary services to rack up the bill and after all that, he told me  I  have a leak pipe somewhere by the skimmer.  I  called two other pool companies who came and they both told me it is just a cascade and the second company fixed it very cheap.  I  instructed Jeff not to charge my credit card and he laughed at me and hung up.  I  ended up filing fraud with my bank to get my money back. THEY ARE THE MOST DISHONEST UNPROFESSIONAL AND UNETHICAL PEOPLE. DO NOT DO BUSINESS WITH THEM IF YOU VALUE YOUR MONEY!!!
reviews.author: Bryan Habibi

reviews.text: Daryl has been our pool guy for over a year. Extremely professional, reliable and flexible when we need to change our schedule. Our pool looks great year around thanks to him. You can't go wrong using A Affordable Pool & Spa.
reviews.author: Joe Adams

reviews.text: Was getting tired of cleaning my pool and our next door neighbor recommended Affordable Pool in Carrollton.   These guys are awesome and really easy to work with.  Very Professional and knowledgeable.  I couldn't image using another pool service.
reviews.author: annie stansfield

reviews.text: Bob did a wonderful job getting the new pool pump installed.  We were under a time crunch and he really came thru for us. Thank you!!
reviews.author: Melanie McManigal

reviews.text: We had received a pool school tutorial and a few pieces on our motor replaced. They also did a tune up on our pool cleaner/sweep. The service was professional and would definitely use them again.
reviews.author: Monica Zaragoza

reviews.text: A-Affordable Pool & Spa responded to our request for service quickly, and completed the work as promised! Several other companies were unwilling to repair our auto-fill, or had excessive long waiting lists for the repairs we needed. Our pool is fully operational, and looking beautiful again, because of the team at A-Affordable!! Thank you!!
reviews.author: Debbie Cano

reviews.text: They were very professional and knowledgeable. Helped me fix an algae issue I have been having with my pool for over two months where Leslie’s was more interested in selling me chemicals that did nothing to FIX the problem.
reviews.author: Ken Boyd

reviews.text:
I had my  16 year old pool repaired for cracks and resurfaced with quartz plaster in 2015. The owner and the working team were very professional and completed the project on time within the quoted price and with excellent quality.
I would recommend Affordable Pool & Spa to all my colleagues,  friends and family.
reviews.author: vincent pillai

reviews.text: We have had great experiences with A Affordable. They are trustworthy, fair and responsive. Their work is excellent. We can highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Kathy Goria

reviews.text: Stopped in to get advice on a blown water temp sensor.  Nick was not only knowledgeable on the subject, but was also able to locate a replacement within minutes.  With the shop just minutes from the house, we look forward to doing more business with A-Affordable in the future.
reviews.author: George Whaley
